# Third-party dependency

`libopencm3-clock` contains the libopencm3 source, headers, build support, licenses,
and a prebuilt STM32F1 static library used by this project.

- Upstream: https://github.com/libopencm3/libopencm3
- Original checkout HEAD: `3a85f91ed8bfe3322cda4ccec63eae2717f67f00`
- Library/source notices retain their original LGPL-3.0-or-later terms.
- Build support may use GPL-3.0-or-later; see individual files and bundled licenses.
- The copied Git metadata, generated object files, and upstream docs/tests are excluded.
- The original local development copy `libopencm3/` is not part of this repository.

The source is supplied so the library can be rebuilt and the firmware relinked.
